utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll start the list and see what we already have. If you can bring the drill and screws, that should help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on for this afternoon. I’m checking the list now, and the drill and screws would be great.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still checking the list so we don’t miss anything for the repair drive. If we’re short on tools, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks—just let me know if you want me to help spread the word or check who can bring extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I may take you up on that. I’m still sorting the list, and once I know what’s missing, I’ll let you know who to contact.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara, I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive moving. Let me know what you need from me, and I’ll help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I can help sort and load, and I’ll be there around 2. If you want, we can aim to start right after school lets out, around 3:30, so families can swing by after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Mara — 3:30 works well. I’ll keep things organized and make sure we’re ready to start right after school gets out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Oren, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? Have we settled which repairs we’re covering?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — I’m still in, and I can help sort out the donated tools by the porch. What repairs do you want me to focus on?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — could you focus on the donated tools and flag anything missing? I’m checking the latest repair list now, including the roof patch.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s mostly little fixes—patching, painting, and a few broken bits people have been meaning to handle. I’m just trying to round up help and see who can pitch in where.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’m planning to swing by the repair drive and see what they need, and I’ll let you know as soon as I pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, thanks—just let me know when you’re coming by. I can check in later too and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Could you help sort the donated tools by the porch?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I heard the donated tools and spare parts are being dropped off by the community center today. I can bring a wrench and some screws by later if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Tess. Thanks — just bring them by later if you can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up too, but I heard they’re collecting donations and tools for the fixes. If there’s a latest list, I’d love to see it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can help with sorting the donations and loading the bigger items. If you’re free, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I can help sort too, if you send me the latest list. I’m still catching up, so just point me to what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep it simple and send over the list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — send the list my way, and I’ll see what I can spare or round up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll send the list over shortly, and thanks for checking what you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s start with the most urgent repairs first—what’s broken, and do we already have a supply list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, let’s tackle the urgent stuff first — I’m not totally sure on the full supply list yet, but I can check what’s been gathered and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that would help—can you check what’s been gathered and tell me the missing supplies? Once we know that, we can sort the urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we still need and make a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that’ll help a lot. I’ve got Maple Street first, then we’ll move down the block.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll check our stock and jot down what’s missing, then I’ll bring the list over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work well—3:30 is perfect after pickup. Do you want me to help spread the word to the other parents?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d be great—thanks. I can help with the list too if you want, I just need to catch up on what’s already covered.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I’d love that—if you can help with the list, I can fill you in on what’s already covered.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Sam—I’ll add your name right now. Glad you’re joining us!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn—happy to help. If you need me to handle pickup or drop-off, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be wonderful, Sam — I’ll let everyone know you can help with pickup or drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Tess — I’ll make a quick list of what we still need, and I can compare it against the tools we already have.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Cleo — a list will help a lot. I’ll keep an ear out and tell you if I hear anyone mention extra tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Tess — I’ll pull the list together and then we can spot any gaps fast.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s mostly little fixes—patching, painting, and a few broken bits folks have been meaning to get to. I’ll stop by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds good—when you stop by, let me know the starting location and I’ll help keep track of where everything needs to go.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I’ll check in later and tell you where they want things to go. Thanks for helping keep track.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll check the latest list and confirm the roof patch. Anything else you think should be included?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’m still a bit behind, so I’d go with the roof patch and whatever other basics are on the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll stick with the roof patch and the basic items on the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take a pickup or drop-off shift if that helps, and I can check in with a few neighbors about bringing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a big help, Rey — thanks. If you can check in with folks and maybe swing by the community center, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll check in with a few neighbors and swing by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m already spreading the word, and I can add you to the repair drive list too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate you including me—just let me know what’s needed later.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You bet—I’ll keep you posted as details come in, and I’m glad you’re in!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I can help spread the word to the other parents.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. Just let me know the time and place, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — it’s at 3:30 right after school, and I’ll send the location details soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for the reminder. I can help sort the donated tools by the porch—just point me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks Oren — start with the boxes by the porch, and I’ll bring over the list so we can separate duplicates and missing items.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll start with the boxes by the porch and keep an eye out for duplicates. Bring the list over when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s start with the broken items and a quick supply list first, then we can pick a time. If you can bring tools, I’ll handle snacks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — I’m mostly trying to confirm who’s handling pickup and drop-off, and whether we have enough people to cover everything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good point — let’s confirm pickup and drop-off first, then see if we need any extra hands. How many people do we have so far?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, go ahead and put me down — I’ll swing by a little later and help out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Dane — I’ve got you down. Swing by later and we’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll see you a bit later and help wherever I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—last I heard, it’s still going on, and they’re collecting donations and tools for the fixes. I might’ve missed a change or two, though.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for the update — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind folks to bring donations and tools by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — Saturday, got it. Thanks for keeping me in the loop; I’ll try to remember that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll be there around 2 to help sort and load.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, 2 works for me. I’ll bring the list and we can start with the urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll be there at 2 and we can start with the urgent fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s still happening this afternoon. If you want, I can help keep track of anything we still need for it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming. I’ll keep an eye out this afternoon.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
